items.briefing:
Fraudsters are increasingly using AI tools to carry out more convincing scams, including in the mortgage and financial sectors. Australian organisations should be aware that AI is being used on both sides — by defenders to detect fraud, and by criminals to make their attacks harder to spot. Separately, online scam content continues to flood the internet, meaning staff may encounter more convincing phishing emails or fake websites than ever before.

A practical reminder: if you receive an unexpected request — especially involving money, login details, or personal information — verify it through a separate, trusted channel before acting. When in doubt, pick up the phone.

featured.title: AI is the new battleground in mortgage fraud detection
featured.quote: AI-generated fake payslips expose critical vulnerabilities in Australian mortgage lending processes.
